description: Code-level criteria for the two properties the behavioral tests cannot observe: that the edge gutter is reused rather than re-invented, and that the offsets stay derived from measured geometry.

criteria.criterion: In packages/react/select/src/Select.tsx, the left-to-right branch of the pop-up positioning logic bounds the pop-up's left offset using the same CONTENT_MARGIN value the component already uses for its other edge spacing.

In packages/react/select/src/Select.tsx, the right-to-left branch of the pop-up positioning logic bounds the pop-up's right offset using the same CONTENT_MARGIN value the component already uses for its other edge spacing.

In packages/react/select/src/Select.tsx, the corrected starting-edge offset is computed from the trigger/content bounding-box measurements and window.innerWidth that the surrounding code already reads at run time, so the same computation holds for any window width, element width, or text length rather than one tuned to the fixture's specific dimensions.
